Official p.15, 2F plan: ⑬ is the hatched-circle VVF joint box (about x505, y180). Four cables connect to it:
- L-2 circuit ⓒ.
- The イ fluorescent group on the left.
- The right-hand fluorescent group, labelled ロ with small katakana next to the lamps.
- The line through ① to the ⑭ switch group (イロハ, with ハ marked 3 for a 3-way switch).

The ハ 3-way switch runs down the riser (arrow at about x618, y130) to the 1F stair lamp ハ (about x605, y505). On 1F, that lamp connects only to the riser and to the 1F 3-way switch (3ハ). Its supply and neutral therefore come through ⑭, ① and ⑬ from L-2 circuit c.

The photos show red with 2 ports, clear/pale blue with 3 ports and yellow with 4 ports. That gives red ×3 + yellow ×1, matching the official answer イ.
